title: Never give up. Believe in yourself. #shorts #trendingshorts #business #motivation #hustle
description:
"6 years. 5 failed businesses. ₹2 crores earned... and lost."

They called me Elon Musk. Then, half my body got paralyzed.

I was down to my last ₹4,000-couldn't even pay my co-founder's salary. But I found a way to send him ₹36,000. He had responsibilities.

People told me to quit. My grandma questioned me. My dad called it playing business. My mom lost belief. My best friend betrayed me. I cried.

But I never stopped believing. I always had food and a home. That was enough.

Today, Refer Rush was selected as 1 of 9 startups out of 2400+ for the The TFund grant.

It took us 4 months to generate ₹1 lakh for our customers. Now, we generate ₹1.5 lakhs a day. We're profitable.

And we're just getting started.

The first five years aren't where you win they're where you get good.

Grateful for my parents. For Rohan. For this opportunity. For this life.

Never give up. Believe in yourself. Every e-commerce brand in the world will use Refer Rush.
